meta.rootTitle: Politicas — the empirical record of the republic
meta.rootDescription: Votes, public money, budgets and laws fused into one methodology-transparent effectiveness index for every Czech politician. Every number cites its open data source.
meta.dashboardDescription: Chamber overview: composite scores, the ranking, events in the public-money graph, and entry points to five tools.
meta.votetrackDescription: A ledger of roll-call votes, the chamber view and parliamentary-group discipline — three perspectives over psp.cz data. Feeds the Activity, Attendance and Independence pillars.
meta.moneyDescription: Public contracts, subsidies and donations traced through firms to politicians — an entity graph, a ledger of evidenced ties, and the trail methodology. Feeds the Integrity pillar.
meta.budgetDescription: A town's finances against similarly sized peers: debt per capita, capital-spending share and balance, from MONITOR / State Treasury data.
meta.lawwatchDescription: What actually changed in the law: section-by-section diffs linked to roll-call votes, and the legislative pipeline of House prints.
meta.civicscoreDescription: All 200 MPs by composite effectiveness score: the chamber distribution, the full ranking with a party filter, and a head-to-head of two MPs pillar by pillar.
meta.profileDescription: Composite score {score}/100 ({party}, {region}): pillars, roll-call votes and evidenced money ties. Every number cites its open source.
meta.rentgenDescription: Archived art direction of Politicas: an X-ray of the state — the money-trail graph, an audit log and a source register.
meta.graphDescription: A searchable knowledge graph of Czech politics: people, companies, public money, votes and laws in one network, every node linked to its register.

h-412.title: Amendment to the Public Procurement Act

lc1.summary: Beneficial-owner details of the supplier are now mandatory before contract signing.
lc1.before: The contracting authority may request the beneficial-owner details of the selected supplier.
lc1.after: The contracting authority requires the beneficial-owner details of the selected supplier before signing; without them, it will not conclude the contract.

lc2.summary: An internal reporting system is now required for municipalities over 5,000 residents.
lc2.before: The duty to set up an internal reporting system applies to municipalities with more than 10,000 residents.
lc2.after: The duty to set up an internal reporting system applies to municipalities with more than 5,000 residents.

lc3.summary: Full digitisation of building permits postponed by 12 months.
lc3.before: The builder portal applies to all proceedings started after 1 July 2026.
lc3.after: The builder portal applies to all proceedings started after 1 July 2027.

page.lead: The whole knowledge graph, searchable and clickable — people, parties, committees, companies, contracts, bills and laws in one network. Every node carries its provenance and a link to the register where it can be verified.
page.unavailable: The graph isn't available in this run — it's waiting on a connected data warehouse. The other surfaces still run on sample data.

inspector.footnote: provenance = a record of our computation · register = verification at the source

noSource.person: The MP's canonical page on psp.cz is listed above; we don't maintain any other register for this person.
noSource.party: psp.cz only maintains a directory of bodies, not a page for a single parliamentary group — a link would promise more than it can deliver. It stays at the psp id.
noSource.organ: psp.cz only maintains a directory of committees and commissions, not a page for a single body. It stays at the psp id.
noSource.bloc: A bloc is a derived node — it comes from a computation over the co-voting matrix. No register maintains it; its source is the provenance below.
noSource.theme: A theme is a derived node — it comes from classifying votes. No register maintains it; its source is the provenance below.
noSource.company: This node is missing an IČO, so a link into ARES or the company register can't be built.
noSource.contract: We don't have the supplier's IČO stored for this contract, which is what we use to query the Contract Register.
noSource.bill: This bill is missing the number psp.cz uses to reference it.
noSource.law: The law citation in the record has no recognizable number and year, so a link into e-Sbírka can't be built.
noSource.notice: The source data for the notice does carry a URL, but our ingest doesn't carry it through to the node yet. Reconstructing it would mean guessing — it stays at the case number.
